summary: Completed Phase 2 testing of BIONIC™ Territory Inventory module. All 10 requested features tested and working. Backend APIs: 26/26 tests passed. Frontend: All 4 tabs (IA, Carte, Scraping, Partenaires) functional with Leaflet map displaying 48 markers.

minor.issue: Fixed - coords.get() was failing when coordinates was None instead of empty dict

issues: Cookie banner overlays content and may interfere with tab clicks - recommend auto-dismiss or smaller banner

critical_code_review_comments: All APIs properly handle MongoDB ObjectId serialization
GeoJSON API generates coordinates for territories without lat/lon based on province defaults
Scraping is MOCKED - uses hardcoded lists for Sépaq and ZEC data instead of real web scraping
Leaflet map properly displays 48 territory markers with custom icons
Convert to Partner API correctly updates territory and creates partnership request
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing 48 territories
